steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Make way, make way~!
The door the Underground Puppets failed to breach melts under a single blast from Summer's drone, shocking everyone behind it.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: What are you doing? The Institute's access has been revoked completely. You have no right to...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: That's where you're wrong. I know this isn't my turf. I'm just following our handsome Chief's orders, lending a hand on behalf of the MBCC Sinners.
steps.female_content: That's where you're wrong. I know this isn't my turf. I'm just following our beautiful Chief's orders, lending a hand on behalf of the MBCC Sinners.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Now then, let us welcome the true heroes of the BR-003 Observation Hub...
The four researchers step back into the control room after three days away, returning to their familiar stations.
Thanks to the chaos, the data transfer progress hasn't even reached 5%. They quickly repair the system, but with only 15% of access rights at their disposal, there's very little they can do.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: The Mania dimension has entered a deeply entangled state. Certain areas are exhibiting local symmetry. Selecting this area for calculation should reduce the complexity. Confirm?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Proceed with it, but don't commit to it completely. Send all collected data to MBCC. Have both groups run parallel analyses.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: This area has been compromised by Mania. The subjective perception of on-site personnel is likely distorted. A comparison between the internal and external groups will be valuable.
Others try to stop them, but no one can hold back the former Chief Scientist now.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Look around you. Stalled calculations. Damaged equipment. Injured personnel. BR-003 could fall into enemy hands at any moment. So tell me, among the people giving you orders, is there anyone who can actually handle this?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: No one! Then why are you still standing in my way? Move aside. We're taking over. Summer!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Bingo! Leave defense and data collection to me. I can run some new tests while I'm at it too.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Aw, this takes me back to five years ago. Hope we haven't gotten rusty. I'll leave the detailed model calculations to you guys!

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: You don't say.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: Model at 82% completion. 328 anomalous data points detected. Barrie!

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: Verifying them. I'll leave the hardest part to you, Lemma. Can you handle it?

She lifts her head and takes in her surroundings. The interrupted calculations. The equipment damage. The casualties. The crumbling environment. Every passing second brings this place closer to total annihilation.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...Of course.

She turns her gaze to the three Schorls hovering nearby. 83% of all access rights are on them. Without reclaiming them, Lemma cannot reverse this crisis. But she also knows exactly how these triangular minds operate.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Level 6 warning. Your actions have violated multiple security regulations, including unauthorized intrusion into EDGE jurisdiction and disruption of critical ongoing operations.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: All your actions have been recorded and submitted for evaluation. Based on the results, we will proceed to implement...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Whatever. I'm the one on site, so I'll decide what needs to be done. Once this is over, you can check your data logs and make all the "rational evaluations" and "disciplinary decisions" you want. And one more thing...
She looks at Schorl, meeting the eyes watching and judging her behind it.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...All of you are watching, aren't you? Are you holding a meeting right now? Perfect. I have something to say. Let me join you.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You are not authorized to attend this meeting. EDGE-07's authority has been revoked. Your channel has been closed. Return to your cell, Lemma Herzfeld. You will still be given a chance if you...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Stop wasting time! ${PlayerName} has already granted me temporary authorization. Now, under SHP-13's authority, I demand immediate access to this meeting!

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is...?!

The cracked Schorl that ${PlayerName} has always carried emerges from Lemma's pocket. Having been offline for so long, calculating dimensions and slipping through fissures now have truly pushed it to its limits. The little bipyramid bears several fresh scars.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Connection re-established. Syncing data now. SHP-13 has an emergency proposal to discuss with everyone.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: But SHP-13 is currently engaged in combat. In this state of emergency, former Chief Scientist of the Ring Research Institute, Lemma Herzfeld, will speak on SHP-13's behalf. Request submitted. Awaiting approval.
The communication channel falls silent. Receiving no instructions, the Schorls all appear somewhat confused. Then, a heavily distorted signal cuts in...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02: </color>Approved. This is indeed a state of emergency. Grant her access. Let's hear what she has to say.
[System: SHP-13 [Proxy] has joined the meeting]
[Representatives present: 02, 03, 04, 05, 06] [Absent: 01, 08] [Vacant: 07]

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>This violates the rules. We must...
SHP-13 [Proxy]: <size=45>The only two representatives on-site, 02 and 07, are both scientific experts. Both have determined that the Observation Hub is in a state of emergency. 06 can also supply additional information on the battlefield from the FAC perspective.</size>
SHP-13 [Proxy]: Do any other representatives not currently on-site have other more substantive objections?
...
...
...
SHP-13 [Proxy]: Good. I will now recap the situation.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: I'm sure you're all aware of the severity of the attack and the damage sustained. The Underground's dimensional interference is too intense. We must activate real-time calculations immediately.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: However, among the researchers present on-site, 02 is held in the data center conducting the critical data transfer, and the current Chief Scientist's position is unclear.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: I am the only one here capable of executing this task. I am familiar with the Observation Hub, and I have an experienced team ready to support me. I have also worked with the MBCC Chief in the past.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: As soon as EDGE restores my authority for the Observation Hub system, I will act immediately and resolve this crisis as quickly as I can.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05: </color>A feasible plan. However, we must address an additional concern. Namely, the concept of replaceability established during our previous meeting. Technology is no exception to this rule.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05: </color>EDGE has always been cautious when it comes to revoking its resolutions. Doing so entails considerable additional costs and risks.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-04: </color>I agree. Reinstating the former 07 is not our only option. The alternative candidate for 07 is ready to take on the position. This individual has the required scientific expertise, but was simply prevented from boarding the Hub in time by the traitor Isomer. Had this candidate joined the team as scheduled, we would not be facing this predicament now.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-04: </color>It is not too late. The FAC can still send 06 to the Hub. Better alternative options are still available. There is no need to revoke our resolution.
Lemma closes her eyes. Once, she too argued like this, striving to claim the seat she regarded as the ultimate honor.

The resolve she held then remains unshaken even now. She won't run away. Their ruthless enemy is right here, and she needs to be there on the front line, to witness their difference in strength. With her helpless allies right behind her, she must use her knowledge to show them the way forward. Her talent exists for this very moment!
...But now Lemma understands. These people don't actually care.
But it's alright.
She doesn't need anyone's praise. She doesn't need everyone's approval. She has something she must do... and it can only be done from that position.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: You're right. Making any member irreplaceable could be detrimental to an institution as important as EDGE.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: Mania is evolving, and the enemy is growing ever more brutal. Any of us could fall on the front line.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: If anyone was deemed irreplaceable, it would mean the loss of this person could cripple the organization entirely. Humanity cannot entrust the future of our civilization to EDGE if it's so fragile.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: From a rational standpoint, replacements are inevitable. If there is in fact an available substitute for 07, then my personal appeal should indeed be denied.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: However, I am not the only person at this meeting whose reliability must be questioned.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: You've prepared plenty of replacements for me. But what about yourself, <color=#fb9259>02</color>?
SHP-13 [Proxy]: You were the assassination target today. You were the one who could have died. If no one is irreplaceable, where is your replacement?
SHP-13 [Proxy]: Do you have one ready?
Silence. No one refutes her point. Lemma takes a deep breath.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: Now, here's a modification to my proposal.
SHP-13 [Proxy]: I am not merely asking for the seat of 07. I'm asking to be 02's backup while serving as 07. This is the true duty of 07.

SHP-13 [Proxy]: You found a way to produce 07s. But what about your own successors?
SHP-13 [Proxy]: Can those obedient protégés you handpicked grow up to become the next EDGE-02?

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: Hahahaha...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: My own replacement? I did prepare one, actually. Designed an elaborate, costly test just for her, with you as the sacrifice... but my plan failed.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: I thought that was unfortunate, but now...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: I suppose I should thank you.
[System: Entering top authority discussion]

steps.speaker: EDGE-02
steps.content: Good, Lemma Herzfeld, very good. You enlisted some rather extraordinary help, but your growth is indeed astonishing. This merits a special exception.

steps.speaker: EDGE-02
steps.content: Now then. Let's transfer the authority and restore your EDGE access rights temporarily. Accept your test...

steps.speaker: EDGE-02
steps.content: The predetermined calamity is imminent. All of humanity must be prepared, and you and I are no exception. You must work toward becoming a candidate for the top three seats. Should anything happen in the future, I wish to entrust this path to you.

steps.speaker: EDGE-02
steps.content: Out of all my research achievements, you're one I'm particularly proud of.

steps.speaker: SHP-13??
steps.content: One day, I will take the seat of EDGE-02, but I will never walk the path you laid out for me.

steps.speaker: SHP-13??
steps.content: You disgust me!
<color=#fb9259>[System: EDGE-07 permissions restored]</color>
[Back to Reality]
A violent surge of brainwaves snaps her back to her former position in an instant. This time, however, she will not waver.

steps.speaker: EDGE-07
steps.content: Effective immediately, <color=#fb9259>EDGE-07</color> will take direct command of the BR-003 Observation Hub. All data, assets, personnel, and computing resources will be under my control.

steps.speaker: EDGE-07
steps.content: Dimensional verification and modal convergence complete. Three eigenspace sets have been solved. All non-computational personnel, give your full support to the MBCC, lock onto the nearest fissure device, reactivate it, and initiate a ten-second countdown.

As if brainwashed, the three Schorls nearby snap into formation, gathering behind Lemma. Together with two other Schorls, they form five computational hubs. With their access rights assembled, data run at top speed, reaching the allies on the front line.

steps.speaker: EDGE-07
steps.content: And now...
She opens up a communication channel, connecting to a chaotic space, into their ruined hideaway. Isomer and ${PlayerName} are there. Lemma takes a deep breath and shouts.

steps.speaker: EDGE-07
steps.content: Isomer!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She had plenty of ways to deal with you guys, but... she never used them. She always tries to keep the door closed, to keep all the most difficult problems locked outside. She wants to handle them all by herself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I think she loves the view on the other side. She's just forgotten how to open the door.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Help her find her conscience again, Lemma.

steps.speaker: EDGE-07
steps.content: I know everything you've done! How could you let yourself be fooled by someone like that? You've twisted EDGE's purpose, forgotten a scientist's mission, and squandered your time and talent on something completely worthless.

steps.speaker: EDGE-07
steps.content: You idiot! Open your eyes! If you still can't see the truth, then look at me!

steps.speaker: EDGE-07
steps.content: I'll show you what a real EDGE-07 looks like!
[Background shakes and turns blue]
In an instant, every disabled node reboots and reconnects, forming a vast network that covers the Observation Hub's Mania field once more, like a sturdy skeleton holding up the collapsing space.
A figure gradually emerges within the fissure.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: ...I see. You let me go after that woman on purpose...

steps.speaker: Option
options: Yes, you opened up a real path.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry for setting you up. Like Lemma said, I wasn't exactly playing fair. Just like you, I'm calculating and shrewd.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I'm not alone, Isomer. What about you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You still have a chance to say it aloud. Tell them what you really think.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You fought so hard to reach the top, but what you really want is in fact...

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: If you're still asking that question... then you're not as cunning as you think you are, Chief.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: You're just as naive as her.
An unfamiliar rush of Mania shoots out without warning, hitting your shoulder and slamming you into the wall behind.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: That Mania is...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That power isn't clean. Don't use it! If you succumb to it, there's no turning back!
Turning back? Isomer hears the words and almost laughs.
Even now, you still don't get it. That woman isn't testing her candidate's competence, but whether they can always make the most "rational" decision.
Someone who swears to secure their place in EDGE yet still hesitates to wipe away a stain is bound to fail the test.
Now, she's become the test. But what matters more is...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Isomer, drop it! We're not here to crush you! Everyone's waiting for you to come back!!
Your shouts fall on deaf ears. She merely watches, as if gazing at the people standing behind you.
A long moment passes. Then, a soft sigh.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: There's no place left for me here anymore...
[Enter CG]

The chaos cube is unleashed completely, releasing all the crimson threads coiling within. The power of death wraps around Isomer as the Mania field begins to change drastically. Every port under her command succumbs to total corruption.

The Ring Weapons are contaminated. Puppets are running rampant. The system is paralyzed, and the barriers are shattered. And at the center of the stage emerges a newly born S-Class Sinner. What a perfect curtain call.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: From this moment on, I'm a Sillage Society spy. This is the kind of pressure an invasion from the Underground should bring.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Beating that woman won't be easy. You need to try harder, all of you. Come on. Time for a test.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Let these "geniuses" prove their worth!
